scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @forms/api && npm run build -w @forms/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @forms/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -b --pretty && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && node scripts/with-migrate-url.mjs tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.setup: npm run db:roles && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.test:isolation: npm run build:shared && vitest run --project isolation
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && vitest run --project unit
